name: web_search
description: Search the live internet and read web pages. Run a web or news search and get back a ranked list of results (title, URL, snippet), a short synthesised answer with its sources, or the readable article text of any URL. Backed by a configurable search provider (Tavily/Brave/SerpAPI/Bing/Google), with a keyless DuckDuckGo fallback.
usecases: you need current information from the internet — recent events, prices, docs, releases, anything past your training data
you need to check a fact or find sources before answering
you need the latest news on a topic
you have a URL and need to read what is actually on the page (article text, docs, an API reference)
you need a quick synthesised answer to a question plus the sources it came from
howToTalk: Signal it with `function` naming the operation. `search` (default) takes `query` and returns `results` = [{title, url, snippet, published?}]; pass `count` (1-25) to size the list. `news` is the same but recent-news-scoped. `answer` takes `query` and returns a short `answer` plus its `sources`. `fetch` (alias `read`) takes `url` and returns the page `title`, readable `text` and outbound `links`. `providers` reports which search provider is active. No space id, token, or credentials — the provider key is baked into the creature.
prompt: Use this to look things up on the live web and to read pages. `search`/`news` return ranked results; `answer` returns a short synthesised answer with sources; `fetch` (a.k.a. `read`) downloads a URL and returns its readable article text plus links. Prefer `fetch` to actually read a result you found with `search`. Everything is global — there is no space binding and nothing to configure per call.

function.description: operation: search (default) | news | answer | fetch | read | providers

query.description: for search/news/answer: what to search for

url.description: for fetch/read: the page URL to download and read

count.description: for search/news: how many results to return (1-25, default 10)

topic.description: for search: set to "news" to bias toward recent news

freshness.description: for news (brave/bing): recency window, e.g. pd (day), pw (week), pm (month)

days.description: for news (tavily): only results from the last N days

tools.name: search
tools.desc: run a web search and return a ranked list of {title, url, snippet}; the default and most-used operation

tools.name: news
tools.desc: search recent news for a topic and return dated results

query.desc: the news topic to search for

tools.name: answer
tools.desc: return a short synthesised answer to a question plus the sources it is drawn from

tools.name: fetch
tools.desc: download a URL and return its readable text (HTML stripped to article text), title and outbound links

tools.name: read
tools.desc: alias of fetch — read the readable content of a URL

tools.name: providers
tools.desc: report which search provider is active and which are configured
